title: Google Ads Agency for Roofing Contractors
html:
Google Ads for Roofers by Campaign Type

Each campaign type does a different job for your roofing business. Search ads catch homeowners who need a roofer now. Local Services Ads put you at the top of the page with pay-per-lead pricing. Already running LSAs?

  • Search Ads

  • Local Services Ads

  • Display & Remarketing

  • Performance

Each ad group matches one service, so your ad copy lines up with what the person typed. That helps you capture high intent searches and turn them into booked inspections.

Most homeowners compare two or three roofing companies before they call. Roofing remarketing ads follow up with people who visited your site but did not reach out. Display ads show your finished roofs on local news and home improvement sites, so your name is familiar when the next storm hits.

Why Google Ads for Roofing Pays Off

Google Ads puts roofing companies in front of homeowners at the moment they need a roof fixed. You can target commercial roofing projects or emergency roof repair calls, down to the zip codes you serve. Paired with your organic search results, search ads give you a steady flow of new jobs you can plan around.

Gain Immediate Visibility Over Competitors

Roofing SEO takes months to build. Google Ads can put your roofing company at the top of the search results as soon as Google approves your ads. Your roofing ad shows up before homeowners in your service area scroll down to the organic listings.

Full Control Over Your Ad Spend

You pay your ad spend to Google directly, so you always see where the money goes.

Uncover opportunities to improve your campaigns and achieve better results.

How Our Google Ads Agency for Roofers Works

Every roofing account goes through the same four steps. You get a clear plan at the start and a report you can read at the end of each month.

Campaign Build & Launch

That includes keyword research, ad copy, location targeting, landing pages if needed, and conversion tracking before anything goes live.

FAQs About Google Ads for Roofers

Search ads can start showing as soon as Google approves them, so phone calls often begin soon after launch. Results depend on your market and competition.

Each page focuses on one service and one action, like calling or requesting a free estimate. With fewer distractions, these pages usually turn more visitors into leads than a general homepage does.
